description: KUNTAU SPACE EXPLORERS is a student team from KUNTAU SCIENCE ACADEMY participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are building KSA OUTPOST 86, an interactive lunar-outpost simulation where players manage oxygen, water, power, food production, radiation protection, and communication delays. Our mission is to make space science exciting and accessible while showing how real astronauts could survive on the Moon through smart decisions, teamwork, and sustainable technology. for the future.
